name: AEB car-to-car rear: functional and SOTIF requirements (demo set)
function: Autonomous Emergency Braking with Forward Collision Warning, front radar, longitudinal control
note: Example requirement set for a demonstration. Performance targets are inspired by the Euro NCAP AEB Car-to-Car test protocol v3.0.2 scenario families; thresholds are project choices, not NCAP scoring rules. SOTIF items follow the ISO 21448 idea of known triggering conditions; exploratory items are analysed but do not block a release.

requirements.title: Avoid a stationary vehicle up to 50 km/h
requirements.text: The AEB shall avoid a collision with a stationary vehicle ahead (100 % overlap, dry road) for ego speeds from 10 to 50 km/h.

requirements.title: Mitigate a stationary-vehicle collision at 55 to 80 km/h
requirements.text: For ego speeds from 55 to 80 km/h the AEB shall avoid the collision or reduce the impact speed by at least 50 %.

requirements.title: Avoid a slower moving vehicle
requirements.text: The AEB shall avoid a collision with a vehicle driving at constant 20 km/h ahead for ego speeds from 30 to 80 km/h.

requirements.title: Avoid a lead vehicle that brakes
requirements.text: With both vehicles at 50 km/h, a gap of 12 or 40 m and the lead vehicle braking at 2 or 6 m/s², the AEB shall avoid the collision.

requirements.title: Warn before braking
requirements.text: When approaching a stationary vehicle or a vehicle at constant speed, the forward collision warning shall start at least 0.8 s before autonomous braking.

requirements.title: Never reduce the driver's braking
requirements.text: The brake request sent to the brake system shall never be lower than the driver's own brake request.

requirements.title: Hold the vehicle after an autonomous stop
requirements.text: After the AEB has brought the vehicle to a standstill it shall hold it (movement at most 0.05 m) while the object is still detected.

requirements.title: No excessively early stop
requirements.text: When the AEB stops the vehicle for a stationary object, the remaining gap shall not exceed 12 m (avoids nuisance interventions the driver would not accept).

requirements.title: Activation speed window
requirements.text: Below 10 km/h the AEB shall neither warn nor brake. Above 85 km/h it shall warn but not start autonomous braking (the driver remains responsible).

requirements.title: Ignore short phantom radar detections
requirements.text: A radar detection that lasts less than 150 ms and has no real object behind it shall cause neither a warning nor autonomous braking.

requirements.title: No reaction to a vehicle pulling away
requirements.text: A vehicle ahead that is faster than the ego vehicle shall cause neither a warning nor autonomous braking.

requirements.title: Wet road
requirements.text: On a wet road (friction 0.6) the AEB should avoid collisions up to 50 km/h and reduce the impact speed by at least 50 % above.

requirements.title: Warning time with the radar range limited by fog
requirements.text: With the radar range limited to 30 m, the forward collision warning should still start at least 0.8 s before autonomous braking.

requirements.title: Collision avoidance with the radar range limited by fog
requirements.text: With the radar range limited to 30 m, the AEB should avoid a stationary vehicle up to 70 km/h.

requirements.title: Late sensor data
requirements.text: With 300 ms sensor latency, the AEB should still avoid a stationary vehicle up to 50 km/h.
